plate_comment: The transfer case low-range detector by N/V (e2m 8C5F / 8C60 'Tcase NV'): filters the road speed, computes engine speed / road speed and its average and percent change, keeps transfer_case_launch_flag and transfer_case_low_range_flag. Runs with algorithm_enable_flags_43_cal.transfer_case_low_range_enable, transmission_type_cal 0 and the engine running (not in this calibration) (was cm848_monitorEngineToVehicleSpeedRatio) | earlier note: Needs algorithm_enable_flags_43_cal bit 5 / EEPROM 0x3fd934 = 0 / engine running (unmet in this calibration): filters vehicle speed and engine rpm over vehicle speed (8 counts per rpm per mph); sets engine_to_vehicle_speed_ratio_high_flag over 300 rpm per mph under 44 mph (was fuelTempTrimComputation) | review-function-readability reviewed 2026-11-13 - Readability Medium Accuracy Confidence High
Clears the three transfer case filters and points them at their e2m 8C5F coefficients (the N/V average, its percent change, the road speed) (was initGovernorTempTableParams)
